about_short_description.short_description: The first Dropshipping platform of Saudi Arabia. It offers products, storage, packaging, and shipping.

product.name: Dropshipping Platform
product.description: A platform enabling online stores to sell products without holding inventory by providing product sourcing, storage, packaging, and shipping services.

product.name: Product Sourcing and Availability
product.description: Provision of a wide range of products, including halal-certified items and Alibaba products, for online stores to sell without inventory investment.

product.name: Storage and Warehousing
product.description: Secure storage facilities for products offered through the dropshipping platform, ensuring inventory is managed and ready for order fulfillment.

product.name: Packaging Services
product.description: Professional packaging of products to ensure safe and secure delivery to customers.

product.name: Shipping and Delivery
product.description: Automated shipping service that handles order delivery from storage to the customer’s address.

product.name: API Integration for Order Management
product.description: API-based integration that connects online stores with M5azn’s platform for automatic order processing and inventory updates.
